provenance.method: slice-and-lift: every rank-3 decomposition of |T>^4 up to symmetry, none extends to |T>^5

notes: A rank-3 decomposition of |T>^5 sliced along one qubit gives a rank-3 decomposition of |T>^4 whose terms are related slice to slice by a Pauli and a fourth root of unity. |T>^4 has one rank-3 decomposition up to its unitary symmetries (the QubitTM4 witness), and no choice of Paulis and phases satisfies the second slice, so rank 3 is impossible at m=5. Puts the cell at 4 <= chi <= 6.
